nothing here is impressive, that's the whole point

#morningroutine #routine #healthylifestyle

slides.text:
The first twenty minutes
decide the whole day

Water before coffee

Every single morning,
no exceptions

Curtains open,
phone stays down

Light first, screen second

Then one card

How I slept decides
how hard today gets

Protein before anything sweet

The 11am crash
starts at breakfast

slides.heading: Twenty minutes, decided for you
slides.body: SOMA turns last night into today's plan before you have finished your first glass of water
